routes.purpose: Single product-level race-day readiness reducer for UI gating.
Event, session, flag, lap, route, and pre-session context.
Timing tower rows, Bryce highlight, point fields, gaps, pace, pit/pass fields.
Bryce timing row, identity/profile, and route context.
NWS venue observation, forecast, alerts, station/grid, probes, and cache state for a requested track; /api/readiness selects active/upcoming INDY NXT track metadata.
SQLite-backed Bryce archive replay and trend sufficiency.
Endpoint-level source diagnostics and readiness inputs.
Historical official/provisional points baseline when live points are absent or stale.

readinessStates.ready: Fresh INDY NXT timing, Bryce car 9 row present, core timing usable.
readinessStates.pre_session: Session context exists but fresh Bryce NXT timing is not active yet.
readinessStates.degraded: Core timing usable with one or more enrichment failures.
readinessStates.wrong_series: Global timing feed is reachable but not the Bryce INDY NXT session.
readinessStates.stale: Only old timing or archived Bryce data is available.
readinessStates.blocked: Required data for honest race-day mode is missing or invalid.

PointsProjectionState.v1Recommendation: Use Race Control point fields when populated and fresh; fallback to compact history when absent, stale, or wrong-series. Do not implement a local official points-table model for v1.

pointsProjection.fallbackWhenAbsentOrStale: Show compact historical standing and mark live projection unavailable, partial, stale, or wrong_series.
reconcileAfterOfficialResults: Compare Race Control live point fields with official race points and championship totals.
Record discrepancies by eventSessionId, driver, entrant, live value, official value, and reason when known.
Promote official result into history-bryce and compact history.
Mark replay/session reconciled only after identity and session keys agree.

liveProofGates: Road America live INDY NXT rehearsal completed.
Primary feeds poll at 1-second cadence for at least 20 minutes during active running.
Timing heartbeat is INDY NXT and Bryce guard passes for car 9 plus DriverID 2143 or exact Bryce Aron identity.
Null numeric values remain null and source-present zero remains zero.
Weather partial failures return sourceState partial with failed probes.
Replay archive reaches ready state with enough samples for rank, gap, pass, status, and source-health replay.
Broadcast lag measured against Race Control timing.

mustHaveBeforeUi: Add remaining readiness reducer fixtures for pre_session, degraded, stale, blocked, weather partial, replay states, and no-Bryce archived fallback.
canHappenDuringUi: Render source labels and degraded widget states.
Build operator source detail view from /api/sources.
Add UI polling backoff for wrong_series, stale, and blocked.
raceWeekendRehearsalOnly: Prove or reject lapDistance, tire, and overtake fields.
completedBeforeUi: Implement first-pass product readiness reducer tests for ready, wrong_series, null-vs-zero, and points fallback modes.
Implement PointsProjectionState builder and fallback modes.
